channel.title: Tech
channel.description: Business news related to the technology industry, including Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Facebook, plus consumer electronics, start-ups, cryptocurrency, media, advertising, streaming, venture capital, antitrust and regulation.

item.title: Latin America has the copper and energy the AI build-out needs. Infrastructure is the test
item.description: Latin America’s copper, oil, gas and rare earths could benefit from rising AI energy demand, if infrastructure and fiscal policy attract investment.

item.title: Taking on Starlink: Europe’s largest satellite factory opens in push to rival Musk
item.description: The 20,000-square-meter mega factory will be able to produce up to 500 satellites annually, making it the world's third-largest satellite production site.

item.title: Robots could be doing household chores in just 1-2 years, Chinese EV firm says
item.description: Xpeng Co-President Brian Gu shared his humanoid robot predictions with CNBC in an interview Thursday.

item.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
item.description: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.

item.title: ‘Your booth is waiting’: Denny’s welcomes Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Denny's reaffirmed its longstanding ties with Jensen Huang following his return as Nvidia CEO, revealing that a plaque had been restored.
